# rustinion_monitor_template_link (Resource)

Applies a monitoring template (own or built-in) to a group, a device, or (neither set) every device of the organization. Removing the link removes the rule state of the devices it no longer covers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template_id` (String)

### Optional

- `device_id` (String)
- `group_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
